# Sai Mehandi & Tattoo

> Sai Mehandi & Tattoo is a New Delhi studio for bridal mehndi, party and Arabic mehandi, tattoo art, nail art, and professional artist training.

## Services

The studio offers bridal mehndi, party and festival mehndi, Arabic mehndi designs, custom tattoo art, nail art, and mehandi, nail art and tattoo training classes.
